title: Mapped SI Engine
text: 使用查找表的火花点火发动机模型，输入 3 路、输出 2 路；{Include turbocharger lag effect} 指定增大时间常数、{Input engine temperature} 指定创建输入端口、{Calibrate Maps} 使用测量数据校准表 selection、{Breakpoints for commanded torque, f_tbrake_t_bpt} 指定断点 1 -by、{Breakpoints for engine speed input, f_tbrake_n_bpt} 指定断点 1 -by、{Breakpoints for temperature input, f_tbrake_engtmp_bpt} 指定断点、{Number of cylinders, NCyl} 指定数量、{Crank revolutions per power stroke, Cps} 指定曲轴转数、{Total displaced volume, Vd} 指定体积、{Fuel lower heating value, Lhv} 指定热值 45e6、{Fuel specific gravity, Sg} 指定比重、{Ideal gas constant air, Rair} 指定常量、{Air standard pressure, Pstd} 指定压力、{Air standard temperature, Tstd} 指定温度、{Boost torque line, f_tbrake_bst} 指定增压迟滞 1 -by、{Time constant below boost line, tau_thr} 指定下方时间常数、{Rising torque boost time constant, tau_bst_rising} 指定上升时间常数、{Falling torque boost time constant, tau_bst_falling} 指定下降时间常数、{Brake torque map, f_tbrake} 指定二维查找表 M -by、{Plot brake torque map} 绘制表格、{Brake torque map, f_tbrake_3d} 指定三维查找表 M -by- N -by- L、{Air mass flow map, f_air} 指定二维查找表 M -by、{Plot air mass map} 绘制表格、{Air mass flow map, f_air_3d} 指定三维查找表 M -by- N -by- L、{Fuel flow map, f_fuel} 指定二维查找表 M -by、{Plot fuel flow map} 绘制表格、{Fuel flow map, f_fuel_3d} 指定三维查找表 M -by- N -by- L、{Exhaust temperature map, f_texh} 指定二维查找表 M -by、{Plot exhaust temperature map} 绘制表格、{Exhaust temperature map, f_texh_3d} 指定三维查找表 array、{BSFC map, f_eff} 指定二维查找表 M -by- N -by- L、{Plot BSFC map} 绘制表格、{BSFC map, f_eff_3d} 指定三维查找表 M -by- N -by- L、{EO HC map, f_hc} 指定二维查找表 M -by、{Plot EO HC map} 绘制表格、{EO HC map, f_hc_3d} 指定三维查找表 M -by- N -by- L、{EO CO map, f_co} 指定二维查找表 M -by、{Plot EO CO map} 绘制表格、{EO NOx map, f_nox} 指定二维查找表 M -by、{Plot EO NOx map} 绘制表格、{EO NOx map, f_nox_3d} 指定三维查找表 M -by- N -by- L、{EO CO2 map, f_co2} 指定二维查找表 M -by、{Plot CO2 map} 绘制表格、{EO CO2 map, f_co2_3d} 指定三维查找表 M -by- N -by- L、{EO PM map, f_pm} 指定二维查找表 M -by、{Plot EO PM map} 绘制表格、{EO PM map, f_pm_3d} 指定三维查找表 M -by- N -by- L，按实例取值。
